raw_segments.text: Or thence from Niger flood to Atlas mount the kingdoms of Almancer, Fez and Suss, Morocco
and Algiers and Tremason, on Europe thence, and where Rome was to sway the world.
In spirit perhaps he also saw rich Mexico, the seat of Montesume and Cusco in Peru, the
richer seat of Adeballapa, and yet unspoiled Guiana, whose great city Geryan's sons call
But to nobler sights Michael from Adam's eyes the film removed, which that false fruit
that promised clearer sight had bred, then purged with Eufrasy and rue the visual nerve,
for he had much to see.
